$comment: The cycling map (packages/cycling-core/README.md): where its OSM data comes from and how ways are classified.

area.$id: Names the published files (data/cycling/<id>/, data/osm/<id>/) and the downloaded extracts (var/raw/osm-extracts/<id>/).
area.$extract: Geofabrik's daily extract of the province, the same area as the basemap.

classify.$calmMaxSpeedKmh: A shared lane, or a residential street open to bicycles, at or under this maxspeed is comfortable (comfort 3) rather than the least (km/h). Guess: Vancouver's local street bikeways are signed 30 km/h.
